verdict.rationale: Kit publishes a documented public REST API with clear reference docs (broadcasts, subscribers, bulk/async processing, OAuth 2.0 authentication) plus webhooks for event-driven integration, explicitly aimed at third-party developers building on the platform. This directly satisfies driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s across candidate paths), and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
